pages.title: Built Once, Built Twice
pages.text: Turn a useful build into a repeatable construction method.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Save your own small build with Schematic and Quill, prepare it at the table, then supply the cannon’s required materials and fuel. Completion is native, not judged by appearance.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Schematic and Quill saves a chosen build, the table prepares it and Schematicannon consumes real materials/gunpowder; finish a nonempty job rather than receive a free base.
